records.competition: Varies by campaign; APRs decay as capital enters.
records.required_work: Participate in eligible DeFi campaigns such as concentrated liquidity, lending/borrowing, token holding, airdrops, or points programs.
records.reward_timing: Rewards are computed periodically and become claimable after Merkle-root updates and dispute windows.
records.safe_next_action: Build a campaign monitor for APR, TVL, chain, required action, gas, and smart-contract risk.
records.why_not_autonomous: Capturing requires wallet signatures and onchain LP, lending, borrowing, holding, or claim transactions.

records.competition: Medium-high; depends on category fee rates and fill quality.
records.required_work: Place maker orders that add liquidity and later fill on markets with fees enabled.
records.reward_timing: Paid daily in pUSD when accrued rebate is at least $1.
records.safe_next_action: Estimate rebate minus adverse-selection loss from public market data.
records.why_not_autonomous: Maker rebates require live filled orders and position risk.

records.competition: High in liquid events; lower in niche markets but with worse adverse-selection risk.
records.required_work: Post resting limit orders on reward-enabled markets. Score depends on two-sided depth, spread, size, and proximity to the adjusted midpoint.
records.reward_timing: Daily distribution at midnight UTC; minimum payout disclosed as $1.
records.safe_next_action: Use public market fields to rank reward density and simulate quote profitability before manual review.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires live CLOB orders, possible fills, wallet/account access, and geographic eligibility checks.

records.competition: High in large pools, medium in smaller target-size markets.
records.required_work: Eligible members post qualifying resting limit orders. Random snapshots score order size, uptime, and proximity to the best bid/ask; pools are split pro rata.
records.reward_timing: Daily program pools; minimum payout disclosed as $1.
records.safe_next_action: Keep the existing Kalshi public API monitor, rank pools, and draft manual order tickets.
records.why_not_autonomous: Capturing requires live resting orders that can fill and create regulated-market inventory risk.

records.competition: No pool competition.
records.required_work: Hold eligible settled cash and meet program requirements, including Robinhood Gold where applicable.
records.reward_timing: Monthly interest; APY changes over time.
records.safe_next_action: Monitor APY versus Treasury money-market alternatives before manual allocation.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires account/subscription and cash allocation decisions.

records.competition: Demand-driven rather than pool competition.
records.required_work: Enable Stock Lending if eligible; Robinhood may borrow eligible whole fully paid shares.
records.reward_timing: Monthly payment when borrowed shares generate at least one cent of monthly rebate.
records.safe_next_action: If you use Robinhood, inspect eligibility and expected holdings before manually enabling.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires account setting changes and acceptance of share-lending risks.

records.competition: High because volume programs favor active traders with lower friction and hedging.
records.required_work: Execute eligible trades in eligible markets during active windows. Reward share is based on eligible volume, with trades generally needing prices above $0.03 and below $0.97.
records.reward_timing: Program-specific; capped by Kalshi rules including a max reward per contract.
records.safe_next_action: Monitor program availability and calculate break-even fee/reward thresholds before any manual trade.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires filled trades, immediate exposure, and venue rule compliance.

records.competition: Demand-driven rather than pool competition.
records.required_work: Enroll eligible fully paid or excess-margin shares so IBKR can lend them when borrow demand exists.
records.reward_timing: Daily accrual when shares are on loan; IBKR says it pays 50% of a market-based rate.
records.safe_next_action: Prepare a manual opt-in/risk checklist if you already hold eligible fully paid securities.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires brokerage account enrollment and accepts SIPC, voting, dividend-tax, and borrower-default tradeoffs.

records.competition: High in major sports pools; medium in smaller categories.
records.required_work: Place resting orders close to the best price. Random order-book snapshots score size by tick distance and target-size eligibility.
records.reward_timing: Calculated after time periods; rewards under $1 are not paid.
records.safe_next_action: Create a pool tracker from published schedules, then require manual approval for any quote.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires live orders and venue eligibility; reward pools do not remove inventory loss risk.

records.competition: High; favors traders with real flow and a reason to cross spreads.
records.required_work: Generate eligible weighted taker volume by category and tier while avoiding abusive or wash activity.
records.reward_timing: Daily pUSD rebates and tier updates.
records.safe_next_action: Only evaluate after true expected-value trades are found; never trade just to earn rebates.
records.why_not_autonomous: Requires intentional taker trading and could incentivize uneconomic volume.

records.competition: High; Base-native yield farmers and vote markets make rewards efficient quickly.

records.safe_next_action: Track candidate pools only when APR beats impermanent-loss and gas-adjusted thresholds.
records.why_not_autonomous: LP and ve-locking actions create impermanent loss, lockup, and smart-contract risk.
